policy_name: SNS Hospice EMR ICD-10 Primary Diagnosis Blocking Policy
purpose: Prevent non-terminal, manifestation, symptom, external-cause, or administrative ICD-10 categories from being selected as the hospice primary diagnosis while still allowing clinically relevant secondary, comorbidity, contributing, and supporting diagnoses.

primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.reason: This category is not appropriate as the hospice primary diagnosis when the underlying terminal disease process should be identified.
primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.user_message: This diagnosis cannot be selected as the hospice primary diagnosis. Select the underlying terminal disease process. This code may be used as a secondary, comorbidity, or supporting diagnosis when clinically appropriate.

primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.category: Symptoms, Signs, and Abnormal Clinical or Laboratory Findings
primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.reason: Symptoms, signs, and ill-defined conditions should not be used as the principal diagnosis when a related definitive diagnosis exists.
primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.user_message: This symptom or sign code cannot be selected as the hospice primary diagnosis. Select the definitive terminal disease process. This code may be used as supporting documentation when clinically appropriate.

primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.reason: Status, encounter, and administrative codes should not drive hospice terminal diagnosis selection.
primary_diagnosis_prefix_blocks.user_message: This status or encounter code cannot be selected as the hospice primary diagnosis. Select the underlying terminal disease process. This code may be used as supporting information when clinically appropriate.

validation_messages.primary_block_default_message: This ICD-10 diagnosis is not allowed as the hospice primary diagnosis. Select the underlying terminal disease process. This diagnosis may still be used as a secondary, comorbidity, contributing, or supporting diagnosis when clinically appropriate.
validation_messages.eligibility_reminder: ICD-10 validity does not automatically establish hospice eligibility. LCD criteria, decline evidence, clinical documentation, CTI support, and physician certification must still be validated.

governance_notes: This policy blocks selected ICD-10 categories as hospice primary diagnosis only.
This policy does not prevent use as secondary diagnosis, comorbidity, contributing factor, or supporting diagnosis unless a future rule explicitly says otherwise.
This file is local, editable, and intentionally separated from database migrations.
Updates to this file should be reviewed before production use.
CMS, NHPCO, ICD-10-CM, LCD, and payer guidance should be reviewed before expanding explicit_never_primary_codes.
